Commissioning Of 1300 KW DC Solar Power Plant
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Management reported a 53.3% year-on-year increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, alongside a 44.5% rise in EBITDA to ₹ 92.3 crores. Profit after tax grew by 42.9% year-on-year to ₹ 65.6 crores during the same quarter. The company is currently undertaking a capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with a capex of approximately ₹ 200 crores, targeting commissioning by September 2026. Furthermore, management noted that optimal utilization of this expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue decrease of -1.0% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 341.6 crores and -8.7% for FY26 to INR 1,276.0 crores, alongside an EBITDA increase of 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive sectors continue to dominate the global demand for ABS resins.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating the consumption of ABS resins.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in end-user industries will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The increasing adoption of premium appliances, smart home solutions and energy-efficient products is driving demand for high-performance engineering plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: The increasing adoption of premium appliances, smart home solutions and energy-efficient products is driving demand for high-performance engineering plastics.

capex_expansion.claim: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

orders_capacity.quote: • Operates two manufacturing facilities at Abu Road (Rajasthan) and Satnoor (Madhya Pradesh), supported by an in-house R&D centre at Abu Road.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. Styrene and Acrylonitrile are import dependent.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.
